newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas mixed as deals done in two months.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas mixed as deals done in two months.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures traded twice on Friday morning as bids and offers were posted in a reasonably tight range in the first five months of the contract by the close of the morning session.
August traded 20 lots at 9.80 pence a therm, down 0.03 pence from Thursday's settlement level, while April '98 rose by the same amount to trade 25 lots at 11.40 pence.
By the close August was offered at 9.80 pence, below the previous settlement level, but in all other months where both bids and offers were posted they straddled Thursday's settlement.
